summary: FedEx Corp files an 8-K to report the SEC effectiveness of FedEx Freight's Form 10 and the board's declaration of a pro rata dividend of 80.1% of FedEx Freight common stock to FedEx stockholders. The spin-off distribution ratio is one share of FedEx Freight common stock for every two FedEx shares held as of May 15, 2026 record date. FedEx retains 19.9% and will divest within 24 months via debt exchanges or distributions. FedEx Freight pays a $4.1B cash dividend to FedEx pre-separation funded by $3.7B notes and a term loan. Trading begins June 1, 2026 under FDXF. No stockholder action required. Watch for post-distribution trading and FedEx's residual stake monetization.
